basic_info.description: Brand new, 1 Bedroom 1 Bath home with Crane Cove and water views. The home includes stunning hardwood floors, a custom closet system in the primary bedroom, window treatments, a glass shower screen, and central A/C. We are now over 90% sold out! Features include Miele appliances and gorgeous marble countertops. Designed by Woods Bagot, 2177 Third is luxury living that is quintessentially San Francisco and features curated amenities like a beautifully landscaped center courtyard, private gym, rooftop terrace, pet spa, residence lounge and co-working space. All photography, renderings & views are representative of the Development.
